PrivacyTermsSupportDelete your data

AI Palm Scanner has no accounts and no server of ours that stores your data, so there is no account to delete. Everything the app keeps is on your own device, and you control it.

On your phone

  • Your reading history (each saved photo and reading) is stored only on this phone. To delete it, open the app, go to Settings, tap Delete my data and confirm. Uninstalling the app also removes it. Android Settings, Apps, AI Palm Scanner, Storage, Clear data removes it too, along with your choices, the age answer and your install code.
  • Our server does not store your photo or reading. The only thing it keeps about you is the free-reading count tied to your random install code. Clearing the app's data gives you a new code. To have the old count removed, email us and tell us the date you used the app; because the code is random and not linked to your name, we may not be able to find it.
  • Your subscription is managed in Google Play, Subscriptions. Cancelling stops renewal; it does not delete data.

Data held by other companies

RevenueCat keeps your anonymous purchase record under its own policy. To ask about it, or to ask us to pass a deletion request on, email us.

Questions or requests

Email mercurysols197@gmail.com and we will answer within 30 days. See also the privacy policy.
